sv.title: Trump överväger strypa chip-export till Kina
sv.summary: Trumpregeringen överväger nya licenser som begränsar export av datorchip till Kina, uppger USA:s handelsrepresentant Jamieson Greer i en intervju med Bloomberg.

en.title: Trump considers curbing chip exports to China
en.summary: The Trump government is considering new licences that restrict exports of computer chips to China, according to US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer in an interview with Bloomberg.
